newsitem.title: UK: FTSE in launch of two pan-European indices - paper.
newsitem.headline: FTSE in launch of two pan-European indices - paper.

text.p: A new set of pan-European stock market indices is being launched through an international partnership between Amsterdam's stock and options exchange and FTSE International, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
The newspaper said that with Europe moving towards a single market and single currency, investors were becoming increasingly interested in investing in shares on a Europe-wide basis.

The FTSE Eurotop 100 and 300 indices, made up of Europe's largest and most liquid stocks, would give investors benchmarks for measuring their performance and would allow them to hedge their market exposure through futures and options trading.
"The Eurotop 300 is being dubbed the 'Footsie of Europe' in the hope it can recreate the success of London's FTSE 100 index," said the Financial Times.
